summary: The Sarus Crane (Antigone crane) is an avian species characterized by specialized plumage and foraging adaptations. It primarily inhabits wetland marshes, flooded paddy fields, and floodplains, where its diet consists primarily of tubers, aquatic plants, frogs, snails, and cereal crops.
